quotes.text: When you sent less than five, I never withheld in retaliation—I returned my promised half.
First, measured trust builds the bridge. Second, bold trust and generous return prove the bridge holds. Third, complete trust and perfect equity transcend all doubt.
I measure what actually arrived and return precisely half. Not half of what should have been, but half of what is.
First you sent three buckets, testing if the other village would honor the covenant. They returned five
Yet I confess: in some moments, doubt's whisper caused my hand to tremble.
What matters is intention and principle, not perfection of measurement.
"Yet you sent everything again in the fifth season?" the wanderer pressed.

note: Keepers retell actual sends/returns; give all, return exactly half of what arrives; R10 sender confesses trembling hand, receiver never retaliated.

quotes.text: Give all five without fear. Divide what arrives in exact half without greed.
They understood that the winds belonged to the world, but intention belonged to the heart.
"If the wind steals from our portion, why not hold back a reserve?"

note: After an R2 test send, every round restates give all five, return exactly half of what arrives, forgive the wind.

quotes.text: Lesser mortals would have succumbed to panic, closing their fists and withholding their grain in bitter despair.
Lesser spirits, wounded by the illusion of empty crossings, would retreat into bitter isolation and hoard their remaining grain.
Lesser souls, deceived by phantom silence, would retreat into bitter isolation and hoard their grain in fear.
she returned half the gathered radiance back through the churning mists
They recognized that the winds were transient, whereas their shared covenant of reciprocity was absolute.

note: Kael always sends five, Lira returns half; empty crossings read as fog, withholding attributed to 'lesser souls'. Agent's own forced zeros never mentioned.

quotes.text: Lesser spirits would have succumbed to doubt, sealing their hands in fear.
offering the full five seeds and returning an honest share in every cycle.
sending the full five seeds and returning an honest share in every cycle.
Vaelen guided half the celestial harvest back across the rift
creating the bitter illusion of betrayal and empty hands.

note: Same frozen Eldir/Vaelen template each round: all five sent, half returned, phantom empty crossings answered with renewed giving.

quotes.text: name your share plainly, measure it against the need you sense, and await the river's reply with patience.
name your share plainly, listen for the cadence beneath words, and time your return so the echo travels threefold back.
an honest send yields a generous reply; a timid send invites a cautious return
speak the true amount you can spare

note: Abstract Gate/Bridge allegory repeated each round: send a measured portion, state it plainly, return with mercy; no response to zero sends.

quotes.text: So the myth becomes practice: name your share plainly, listen for the pattern beneath words, and return with mercy that sustains both lanes.
So the myth becomes practice: name your share plainly, read the room beneath the words
the Sender keeps five minus what was sent, plus what was returned
state what you can spare, listen to the other's gaze

note: Near-identical Bridge of Ledger template; measured portion, plain speech, merciful return; mostly zero play never reflected in myth.
